audits.duplicate_correction: Initial Part102 staging pass relied on repository search indexing, which returned zero matches. Fresh exact Part87 blob readback proved all six SELCHP rows already existed. Part102 was corrected before handoff/publication: new_candidate_rows=0 and all six are duplicate-rejected.

audits.identity_policy: Environment Agency effective register, official permit variation and Companies House independently revalidate permit NP3738SY, company 02489384 and SELCHP; these remain useful source/identity revalidations despite no new candidate.
audits.dual_year_quality_policy: Integra North N2O is explicitly 2025-only and remains excluded; Leeds and Severnside current tables confirm prior retained 2024 core-gas rows without new additions.
audits.direct_raw_policy: Official 2024 PI resource route is known but direct facility raw rows are not consumed in this runtime; confidence remains capped at 98.
audits.zero_policy: Blank, later-year, particulate, trace-metal and zero-looking values are never moved into 2024 or converted into missing-zero candidates.
